title: DefiSalmon
tagline: Ranged LP positions with built-in leverage and hedging capabilities
description:
DefiSalmon is a lending market that takes ranged LP positions as collateral and will present a unified interface for LPs where they can specify their leverage, hedge and price parameters and deploy capital in one smooth transaction.

It's an eth-based "sister project" to DefiTuna, which allows to do this in the Solana ecosystem.
how_its_made:
The (probably incomplete) demo to be presented is a result of a solo vibe-code session, using Claude in Cursor, hacking all pieces of the future protocol in a signle .sol file, deployed using foundry stack with front-end generated with Eth-Scaffold-2.

Prior to the hacking there was a phase of exploration of existing solutions and the state they are in.
